title.en: Unfamiliar Experiences & Everyday Participation

seoTitle.en: Unfamiliar Experiences Reflection: Five Everyday Topics
seoTitle.zh: 陌生体验反思：五个日常主题

description.en: Twenty original descriptions of sensory impressions, following thoughts, wariness, participation and routines, with five complete free guides. Private category records, without a psychosis-risk score, reality verdict or diagnosis.
description.zh: 20条原创描述，回顾感官印象、思路、戒备、参与及日常安排，附五篇完整免费指南。只保留私人类别记录，不生成精神病风险分数、现实裁决或诊断。

introduction.en: Adults can voluntarily recall their own experiences over the past four weeks without choosing an explanation. An unfamiliar impression or uncertain meaning cannot establish what happened outside you, another person’s intention or a future illness. No names, private narrative or evidence is requested.
introduction.zh: 成年人可自愿回顾过去四周自身体验，无需选定解释。陌生印象或含义不确定，不能确定外部发生什么、别人意图或未来疾病。不要求姓名、私人叙述或证据。

instructions.en: Use only recollection. No relevant occasion, unclear recall or withholding can stay unscored. Do not recreate impressions, check reality, seek signs, record people or confront someone to answer. All five full guides and the same support information are public without completion or a threshold.
instructions.zh: 只用回忆作答，无相关机会、回忆不清或保留回答可选未计分。不要为作答重做印象、检查现实、寻找迹象、记录别人或对质。五篇全文与相同支持说明公开，无完成或计数门槛。

title.en: Unfamiliar sensory impressions — Complete Experience Guide
title.zh: 陌生感官印象：完整体验指南

headline.en: Unfamiliar sensory impressions — Complete Experience Guide
headline.zh: 陌生感官印象：完整体验指南

summary.en: The four descriptions concern an impression that is hard to place, an unexpectedly intense sensation, uncertainty between surroundings and thought, and an impression remaining on your mind. They ask about your recollection of an experience. They do not establish whether a sound, sight or other event occurred outside you.
summary.zh: 四条描述涉及印象来源难定位、感觉出乎意料地强烈、对周围与想法之间的不确定，以及印象留在心上。它们询问回忆中的体验，不能确定声音、景象或其他事件是否在外部发生。

scoreReading.en: Four descriptions retain six labels without a clinical score, prediction or reality verdict.
scoreReading.zh: 四条描述保留六类标签，不生成临床分数、预测或现实裁决。

title.en: Unfamiliar sensory impressions — Complete Experience Guide
title.zh: 陌生感官印象：完整体验指南

description.en: The four descriptions concern an impression that is hard to place, an unexpectedly intense sensation, uncertainty between surroundings and thought, and an impression remaining on your mind. They ask about your recollection of an experience. They do not establish whether a sound, sight or other event occurred outside you.
description.zh: 四条描述涉及印象来源难定位、感觉出乎意料地强烈、对周围与想法之间的不确定，以及印象留在心上。它们询问回忆中的体验，不能确定声音、景象或其他事件是否在外部发生。

title.en: Describe the impression without deciding its source
title.zh: 描述印象，不裁定来源

paragraphs.en: The four descriptions concern an impression that is hard to place, an unexpectedly intense sensation, uncertainty between surroundings and thought, and an impression remaining on your mind. They ask about your recollection of an experience. They do not establish whether a sound, sight or other event occurred outside you.
paragraphs.zh: 四条描述涉及印象来源难定位、感觉出乎意料地强烈、对周围与想法之间的不确定，以及印象留在心上。它们询问回忆中的体验，不能确定声音、景象或其他事件是否在外部发生。

paragraphs.en: This page cannot identify a hallucination, verify an interpretation or certify that a medical concern is absent. Do not repeat an experience, make recordings, seek signs or ask someone to prove an explanation for this reflection. A category records a description rather than settling what is real.
paragraphs.zh: 页面不能识别幻觉、核实解释或认证没有医疗担忧。无需为了本回顾重做体验、录音录像、寻找迹象或请人证明解释。类别记录描述，不裁定什么是真实。

title.en: Four descriptions, six separate counts
title.zh: 四条描述，六类独立计数

paragraphs.en: The six label counts add to four selected descriptions. They count neither events nor symptoms, time, severity or likelihood. IDs are not points. There is no total, mean, highest topic, clinical cutoff, prediction or risk category.
paragraphs.zh: 六类标签计数合计四条所选描述，不数事件、症状、时间、严重度或可能性。标识不是点数；没有总分、均分、最高主题、临床界值、预测或风险类别。

paragraphs.en: One often, one sometimes and two unscored remain those four choices. No opportunity, unclear recall and withholding do not become did not notice. All unscored gives no finding. Frequent selections cannot establish psychosis or its cause, and fewer selections cannot exclude a concern or certify safety.
paragraphs.zh: 一条较常、一条有时及两条未计分，就保留这四个选择。无机会、回忆不清或保留回答，不变成没有注意到。全未计分没有发现；频繁选择也不能确定精神病性状态或原因，少量不排除担忧、不认证安全。

title.en: A fictional example without a verdict
title.zh: 一个不作裁决的虚构例子

paragraphs.en: A fictional adult recalls a brief sound that was difficult to place while doing a routine task. They may record their uncertainty without choosing a cause or searching for evidence. If they cannot recall whether that experience occurred, the description can stay unscored. The example does not imply that an external event did or did not happen.
paragraphs.zh: 一位虚构成年人回忆做日常事务时听到短暂声音，却难定位来源。他可以记录不确定，不选原因、不找证据。若不记得这种体验是否发生，可保持未计分。例子不暗示外部事件发生或未发生。

paragraphs.en: This is not an expected answer or an experiment to repeat. Later differences may reflect opportunity, interpretation or what you recall. They cannot establish recovery, deterioration, treatment response or future illness, and they do not prove or disprove an explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 例子不是期待答案或要重做的实验。后来差异可反映机会、理解或回忆，不能确定恢复、恶化、治疗反应或未来疾病，也不证明或推翻解释。

title.en: Original reflection, separate from clinical assessment
title.zh: 原创反思，与临床评估分开

paragraphs.en: These twenty bilingual descriptions and five overlapping editorial topics are original and unvalidated. They are not the Prodromal Questionnaire, PQ-B, PRIME Screen or a clinical psychosis-risk instrument. The four-week window is editorial. No norms, diagnostic algorithm, prediction model or established language equivalence is supplied.
paragraphs.zh: 20条双语描述及五个可重叠编辑主题均为未经验证的原创，不是前驱症状问卷、PQ-B、PRIME Screen或临床精神病风险工具。四周范围为编辑选择，没有常模、诊断算法、预测模型或已建立语言等值。

paragraphs.en: NIMH describes professional assessment and possible causes in its public background material. That source provides no validation or endorsement of this original form. Other attention, sensory or relationship forms keep their own methods; their answers and scores cannot be combined into a clinical conclusion here.
paragraphs.zh: NIMH公开背景说明专业评估与可能原因，该来源不验证或背书本原创表单。其他注意、感官或关系表单保留自身方法，其回答及分数不能在此合成临床结论。

title.en: One optional way to describe an actual need
title.zh: 一种可选的实际需要表达方式

paragraphs.en: If you want support, describe the experience in ordinary language to a qualified healthcare professional, including what is concerning you and what help you want. No detailed sensory account or attempt to reproduce the impression is required by this page. You can stop reflecting whenever you choose.
paragraphs.zh: 若希望获得支持，可以向合格医疗专业人士用普通语言描述体验、担忧及想要的帮助。本页不要求详细感官叙述，也不要求重现印象。你可以随时停止回顾。

paragraphs.en: Reading alone is enough. No result requires disclosure, an exercise, a changed boundary or proof that you can control an experience. A count cannot prescribe a technique, determine treatment or require you to investigate another person or an uncertain interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 只读即可。任何结果都不要求披露、练习、改变边界或证明能控制体验。计数不规定技巧、不决定治疗，也不要求调查别人或不裁定解释。

title.en: Support, stopping and privacy
title.zh: 支持、停止与隐私

paragraphs.en: If an experience is new, concerning, continuing or affecting daily life, you can discuss it with a qualified healthcare professional without completing or reaching a count. This page cannot assess causes, medical need or urgency. Do not delay care or change treatment because of it. If immediate danger is present or you cannot stay safe, seek appropriate local emergency assistance rather than continuing.
paragraphs.zh: 体验若新出现、令人担忧、持续或影响日常，可以向合格医疗专业人士讨论，无需完成或达到计数。页面不评原因、医疗需要或紧急程度，不应据此推迟照护或改变治疗。有即时危险或无法保障安全时，寻求当地合适紧急援助而非继续。

paragraphs.en: All guides and support information are public for every answer pattern. Answers stay only in current-page memory, without drafts, submission, questionnaire analytics or a personal result address. Exit, reload, leaving and retake clear them. Copying includes only the public title and entry, without selections, counts, names or personal explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 全部指南与支持说明对任何组合公开。回答只在当前页面内存，不存草稿、不提交、不作问卷分析、没有私人结果地址。退出、刷新、离页与重做会清除。复制只含公开标题与入口，不含选择、计数、姓名或私人解释。

paragraphs.en: The six label counts add to four selected descriptions. They count neither events nor symptoms, time, severity or likelihood. IDs are not points. There is no total, mean, highest topic, clinical cutoff, prediction or risk category.
paragraphs.zh: 六类标签计数合计四条所选描述，不数事件、症状、时间、严重度或可能性。标识不是点数；没有总分、均分、最高主题、临床界值、预测或风险类别。

paragraphs.en: One often, one sometimes and two unscored remain those four choices. No opportunity, unclear recall and withholding do not become did not notice. All unscored gives no finding. Frequent selections cannot establish psychosis or its cause, and fewer selections cannot exclude a concern or certify safety.
paragraphs.zh: 一条较常、一条有时及两条未计分，就保留这四个选择。无机会、回忆不清或保留回答，不变成没有注意到。全未计分没有发现；频繁选择也不能确定精神病性状态或原因，少量不排除担忧、不认证安全。

paragraphs.zh: 一位虚构成年人对普通评论感到不确定，也注意到自己交流中有所保留。记录可保留不确定，不解释说话者意图；它不指示更信任、更不信任、联系对方或确定含义。

paragraphs.en: This is not an expected answer or an experiment to repeat. Later differences may reflect opportunity, interpretation or what you recall. They cannot establish recovery, deterioration, treatment response or future illness, and they do not prove or disprove an explanation.

paragraphs.zh: 设想一位虚构成年人起床时间变化后觉得熟悉事务更费力，并希望有人帮助一项责任。表单不归因，也不能确定疾病进程。实际需要可以在未完成其余描述时就讨论。

paragraphs.en: This is not an expected answer or an experiment to repeat. Later differences may reflect opportunity, interpretation or what you recall. They cannot establish recovery, deterioration, treatment response or future illness, and they do not prove or disprove an explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 例子不是期待答案或要重做的实验。后来差异可反映机会、理解或回忆，不能确定恢复、恶化、治疗反应或未来疾病，也不证明或推翻解释。

title.en: Original reflection, separate from clinical assessment
title.zh: 原创反思，与临床评估分开

paragraphs.en: These twenty bilingual descriptions and five overlapping editorial topics are original and unvalidated. They are not the Prodromal Questionnaire, PQ-B, PRIME Screen or a clinical psychosis-risk instrument. The four-week window is editorial. No norms, diagnostic algorithm, prediction model or established language equivalence is supplied.
paragraphs.zh: 20条双语描述及五个可重叠编辑主题均为未经验证的原创，不是前驱症状问卷、PQ-B、PRIME Screen或临床精神病风险工具。四周范围为编辑选择，没有常模、诊断算法、预测模型或已建立语言等值。

paragraphs.en: NIMH describes professional assessment and possible causes in its public background material. That source provides no validation or endorsement of this original form. Other attention, sensory or relationship forms keep their own methods; their answers and scores cannot be combined into a clinical conclusion here.
paragraphs.zh: NIMH公开背景说明专业评估与可能原因，该来源不验证或背书本原创表单。其他注意、感官或关系表单保留自身方法，其回答及分数不能在此合成临床结论。

title.en: One optional way to describe an actual need
title.zh: 一种可选的实际需要表达方式

paragraphs.en: You can describe one task that matters to you, what has been harder and the support you want to a qualified healthcare professional. Do not deliberately change sleep, stop medicine or test your functioning to answer. The page does not supply a treatment plan or assess medical urgency.
paragraphs.zh: 可以向合格医疗专业人士描述一项重要任务、哪里变难及希望获得的支持。不要为答题故意改变睡眠、停药或测试功能。页面不提供治疗方案，也不评医疗紧急程度。

paragraphs.en: Reading alone is enough. No result requires disclosure, an exercise, a changed boundary or proof that you can control an experience. A count cannot prescribe a technique, determine treatment or require you to investigate another person or an uncertain interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 只读即可。任何结果都不要求披露、练习、改变边界或证明能控制体验。计数不规定技巧、不决定治疗，也不要求调查别人或不裁定解释。

title.en: Support, stopping and privacy
title.zh: 支持、停止与隐私

paragraphs.en: If an experience is new, concerning, continuing or affecting daily life, you can discuss it with a qualified healthcare professional without completing or reaching a count. This page cannot assess causes, medical need or urgency. Do not delay care or change treatment because of it. If immediate danger is present or you cannot stay safe, seek appropriate local emergency assistance rather than continuing.
paragraphs.zh: 体验若新出现、令人担忧、持续或影响日常，可以向合格医疗专业人士讨论，无需完成或达到计数。页面不评原因、医疗需要或紧急程度，不应据此推迟照护或改变治疗。有即时危险或无法保障安全时，寻求当地合适紧急援助而非继续。

paragraphs.en: All guides and support information are public for every answer pattern. Answers stay only in current-page memory, without drafts, submission, questionnaire analytics or a personal result address. Exit, reload, leaving and retake clear them. Copying includes only the public title and entry, without selections, counts, names or personal explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 全部指南与支持说明对任何组合公开。回答只在当前页面内存，不存草稿、不提交、不作问卷分析、没有私人结果地址。退出、刷新、离页与重做会清除。复制只含公开标题与入口，不含选择、计数、姓名或私人解释。

title.en: Five topics, no combined risk inference
title.zh: 五个主题，不合成风险推断

paragraphs.en: Each topic keeps four selected descriptions and six label counts. Helpful and difficult descriptions are not reversed or combined. Counts do not predict illness or settle an interpretation. All five complete guides are free before answering, midway and after any result.
paragraphs.zh: 每主题保留四条所选描述与六类计数。帮助性与困难描述不反向、不合分。计数不预测疾病，不裁定解释。五篇完整指南在答题前、中途及任何结果后均免费开放。

question.en: Can this identify or predict psychosis?
question.zh: 能识别或预测精神病性状态吗？

answer.en: No. These original descriptions have no validated screening threshold, probability model, diagnosis or prediction. They cannot verify perceptions or beliefs, assess reality or decide medical need. A professional assessment is a separate process.
answer.zh: 不能。这些原创描述没有已验证筛查门槛、概率模型、诊断或预测，不能核实感知或信念、评估现实或决定医疗需要。专业评估是不同过程。

question.en: Must I complete the form or prove an explanation to ask for help?
question.zh: 求助前需要做完或证明解释吗？

answer.en: No. If an experience is new, concerning, continuing or affecting daily life, you can discuss it with a qualified healthcare professional without a count or proof. Do not delay care, change treatment or investigate an interpretation because of this page.
answer.zh: 不需要。体验若新出现、令人担忧、持续或影响日常，可以向合格医疗专业人士讨论，无需计数或证据。不要因本页推迟照护、改变治疗或调查一种解释。

title.en: NIMH: understanding psychosis — professional background only
title.zh: NIMH：理解精神病性状态，仅作专业背景
